sloka: सूर्यदत्तवरस्वर्णः सुमेरुर्नाम पर्वतः ।यत्र राज्यं प्रशास्त्यस्य केसरी नाम वै पिता ।। ७.३५.१९ ॥
transliteration: sūryadattavarasvarṇaḥ sumerurnāma parvataḥ ।yatra rājyaṁ praśāstyasya kesarī nāma vai pitā ।। 7.35.19 ॥

translations.english: There is a mountain named Sumeru, golden due to a boon granted by the Sun, where his (Hanuman's) father, named Kesari, indeed rules.
